name_reason: Follows the file's gfx house style fd2_blit_*/fd2_*_blit_* (cf. fd2_blit_rectangle, fd2_blit_money_digit_sprite, fd2_rle_blit_sprite). Accurately reflects the behavior: in-place palette remap (dst pixel -> remap_table[dst pixel]) gated by a 1-byte-per-pixel sprite mask. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: In-place palette-remap blit gated by a 1-byte-per-pixel sprite mask: for each non-zero mask byte, replace the underlying destination pixel with remap_table[dst_pixel].
logic_summary: Stores sprite_mask[0] (width) into global data_fd2_graphics_sprite_mask_blit_width (0x6017B) and computes row_advance = stride - width. mask_ptr = sprite_mask + 4 bytes (skip the 2-ushort header); row_remain = sprite_mask[1] (height). Outer do/while over rows: reload col_remain from the width global; inner do/while over columns: if *mask_ptr != 0 then *dst = remap_table[*dst]; advance mask_ptr and dst, decrement col_remain. After each row dst += row_advance; decrement row_remain. The mask pointer advances continuously across all rows (never reset per row); only the column counter is reloaded each row, matching the binary's word store / word reload of 0x6017B.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_blit_palette_remap_with_sprite_mask(byte *dst_buf, ushort *sprite_mask, int stride, int remap_table)

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base linear address; pixels are recolored in place. In the sole caller this is an off-screen 0x1c8-stride buffer position (large_game_state_buffer + x + y*0x1c8 + 0x8088).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches usage, no address residue.

params.name: sprite_mask
params.semantics: Mask source: header = (ushort width, ushort height) followed by width*height mask bytes (1 byte/pixel). Non-zero byte selects which dst pixels are recolored. Resolved by the caller from the portrait sheet offset table.
params.reason: Accurately names the masked-sprite source; no address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes (0x1c8 in the sole caller). row_advance = stride - width steps dst to the next row.
params.reason: Standard blit stride name; accurate, no address residue.

params.name: remap_table
params.semantics: Base address of a 256-entry palette translation table, indexed by the existing dst pixel value (out = remap_table[dst_pixel]). Disasm confirms MOV AL,[EDI] then MOV AL,[EAX+EBP] with EBP=remap_table. Caller passes a per-spell remap table from data_fd2_tile_anim_table_base.
params.reason: Accurately names the palette translation table base; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the in-place recoloring of dst pixels plus the width side-effect global.

reads_globals: data_fd2_graphics_sprite_mask_blit_width (0x6017B) -- reloaded per row as the column counter
writes_globals: data_fd2_graphics_sprite_mask_blit_width (0x6017B) -- written once with width at entry, then reused as the per-row column-count source
notes: Source comment block (blitspr.c lines 350-386) is already precise, accurate and ASCII; it matches the decompilation, the disassembly (LODSW width->0x6017B; per-row MOV CX,[0x6017B]; mask byte gate; MOV AL,[EDI] / MOV AL,[EAX+EBP] / MOV [EDI],AL), and the call site -- so comment kept verbatim. Ghidra plate is consistent (same algorithm, same 0x6017B side effect, same param semantics); not contradictory, so left unchanged. Sole caller fd2_execute_aoe_spell_with_caster_portrait_radial_scatter @ 0x21bd0 is an orphan/unreachable AoE-spell effect, but the call site confirms all four parameter semantics. No logic touched. Live Ghidra param names (dst_buf, sprite_mask, stride, remap_table) all kept; any future rename handled in Stage 2.
